test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘STAR’ is written as ‘8110291’, ‘GIFT’ is written as '02697'. How will ‘DOLL’ be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : Position values according to English alphabetic series written in reverse order and rearranged diagonally. So, • ‘STAR’ is written as ‘8110291’
